t: What Electricity Tariff Database Is All About
title: What Electricity Tariff Database Is All About
description: Electricity tariffs price the electrons: flat rates (simple, dull signals), time-of-use (peak 4-9pm costs more), demand charges ($/kW for commercial peaks), and net metering (rooftop solar credited). California's NEM 3.0 cut solar export credits; demand charges punish one bad 15 minutes monthly. Tariffs shape behavior — design them to shape it well. This database is the complete tariff record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Electricity Tariff Database: a complete reference database of full tariff record records.
